entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I bought these mountain bike cycling shoes a while ago, and I'm just so confused.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, I think so. It was on the email, right? It's all a bit overwhelming. Okay, here it is: VF-789012.
Great, thank you. Let me pull that up... VF-789012. I see the order for the VeloFit TrailGrip Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered 43 days ago. Can you tell me what the issue is with the shoes?

They just... they hurt. I tried them on a ride and got terrible blisters on my heels. And the part where the cleats attach feels strange. I read the policy online and I just... I didn't understand it. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.
Of course, I can help. I'm sorry to hear about the blisters. Let me just check our return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, I've checked the policy for this item. Since you received the shoes 43 days ago, you are still well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? That's... that's a relief. So I can get a refund?

Yes, absolutely. I can initiate that return for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label. Just be sure to pack the shoes, including any cleats that came with them, back into the original box and attach the label.
Wow, thank you so much. I was so worried it would be a problem. You've been a huge help.

You're very welcome. The email is on its way. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Diana!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
